architectureNotes: The obligation "every exported function has a test of its error case" reads as if every function has an error case, but `sum` has none: the Errors section only requires a throw where a function is undefined on its input, and `sum([])` returns 0 (test/stats.test.js:6). The add-mean report treats the obligation as not applying to `sum`. If future units add more functions defined on all inputs, the re-plan should word the obligation as conditional so they don't trip over it.
